title: wg: mls-extensions #110 rule 3: does the pre-Commit check cover Add KeyPackage leaves?
description: mls-extensions editor's copy (PR #110) §5 negotiation, rule 3: 'A LeafNode in a group is invalid if ...' then 'A LeafNode in a proposal or in the UpdatePath of a Commit is therefore checked against the GroupContext before the Commit.' Problem: unclear whether an Add proposal's KeyPackage LeafNode (not yet in the group, but validated per RFC 9420 §7.3/§12.2) is checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext, or only against the resulting epoch (rule 5). Implementations will disagree on a Commit that adds a member lacking X while dropping the requirement for X. mimid: decision mimid-krmn.9 (Add leaves only post-Commit). Suggested fix: say 'An Update proposal's LeafNode or the UpdatePath LeafNode', or explicitly include/exclude Add.
notes: 2026-11-02: mimid implements reading B (decision mimid-krmn.9, Mark): Add KeyPackage LeafNodes are checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext, in Commits and standalone Add proposals.
